notes: Each leaderboard row is one pass over the 100 puzzles; two runs used two passes. Standard errors are about 4-5 percentage points, so rows less than about 10 points apart cannot be ranked reliably. At least five runs are recommended.

The benchmark asks for the single best move as judged by Stockfish. In 99 of 100 puzzles the reference move beats every alternative by at least 1.5 pawns, so the score tracks that skill. The creator's wider suggestion of spatial reasoning and planning is hedged and was not tested.
